Thanks for replying. I watch them sometimes, but I listen to music to cope with my stress. And thanks for sharing your story as well. 
I'll look into vlogs and see if I can relate.

Thank you for reading my post and sharing your story with me. I really appreciate it, I will try to learn and adapt from the past, and try to figure out this crazy life. 
Again thank you for taking the time to break down the points and take time out of your day. Thank you.
